bio.text: Jordan Conley is the Green Party candidate for Hawaii's 1st Congressional District in 2026.

In a Honolulu Star-Advertiser candidate questionnaire, Conley listed his current occupation as teacher, coach and fitness trainer, said he has been a group fitness instructor for Hawaii Pacific Health for 12-plus years, and listed the Aiea Neighborhood Board as previous elected office.
Conley said he started a nonprofit, Hapa Mana, in September 2016.
